name: RNA Transcription
blurb: Given a DNA strand, return its RNA complement.
instructions:
# Instructions

Your task is to determine the RNA complement of a given DNA sequence.

Both DNA and RNA strands are a sequence of nucleotides.

The four nucleotides found in DNA are adenine (**A**), cytosine (**C**), guanine (**G**), and thymine (**T**).

The four nucleotides found in RNA are adenine (**A**), cytosine (**C**), guanine (**G**), and uracil (**U**).

Given a DNA strand, its transcribed RNA strand is formed by replacing each nucleotide with its complement:

- `G` -> `C`
- `C` -> `G`
- `T` -> `A`
- `A` -> `U`

~~~~exercism/note
If you want to look at how the inputs and outputs are structured, take a look at the examples in the test suite.
~~~~
introduction:
# Introduction

You work for a bioengineering company that specializes in developing therapeutic solutions.

Your team has just been given a new project to develop a targeted therapy for a rare type of cancer.

~~~~exercism/note
It's all very complicated, but the basic idea is that sometimes people's bodies produce too much of a given protein.
That can cause all sorts of havoc.

But if you can create a very specific molecule (called a micro-RNA), it can prevent the protein from being produced.

This technique is called [RNA Interference][rnai].

[rnai]: https://admin.acceleratingscience.com/ask-a-scientist/what-is-rnai/
~~~~
starter_code:
rna.toRNA : Text -> Optional Text
rna.toRNA dna = todo "implement toRNA"
example_solution:
toRNA : Text -> Optional Text
toRNA dna =
  use List

  checkRnaMapping : Char -> Optional Char
  checkRnaMapping dnaChar =
    Map.get dnaChar (Map.fromList [(?C, ?G), (?G, ?C), (?T, ?A), (?A, ?U)])

  buildRnaStrand : Optional Text -> Char -> Optional Text
  buildRnaStrand rnaStrand dnaChar =
    optionalRnaChar : Optional Char
    optionalRnaChar = checkRnaMapping dnaChar
    Optional.flatMap (rnaChar -> Optional.map (strand -> strand Text.++ (Char.toText rnaChar)) rnaStrand ) optionalRnaChar

  List.foldLeft buildRnaStrand (Some "") (toCharList dna)
test_code:
rna.test.t1 = verify do
  labeled "Empty RNA sequence should be empty string" do
    expected = Some ""
    actual = toRNA ""
    label "expected" expected
    label "actual" actual
    ensureEqual expected actual

rna.test.t2 = verify do
  labeled "RNA complement of cytosine should be guanine" do
    expected = Some "G"
    actual = toRNA "C"
    label "expected" expected
    label "actual" actual
    ensureEqual expected actual

rna.test.t3 = verify do
  labeled "RNA complement of guanine should be cytosine" do
    expected = Some "C"
    actual = toRNA "G"
    label "expected" expected
    label "actual" actual
    ensureEqual expected actual

rna.test.t4 = verify do
  labeled "RNA complement of thymine should be adenine" do
    expected = Some "A"
    actual = toRNA "T"
    label "expected" expected
    label "actual" actual
    ensureEqual expected actual

rna.test.t5 = verify do
  labeled "RNA complement of adenine should be uracil" do
    expected = Some "U"
    actual = toRNA "A"
    label "expected" expected
    label "actual" actual
    ensureEqual expected actual

rna.test.t6 = verify do
  labeled "RNA complement" do
    expected = Some "UGCACCAGAAUU"
    actual = toRNA "ACGTGGTCTTAA"
    label "expected" expected
    label "actual" actual
    ensureEqual expected actual

rna.test.t7 = verify do
  labeled "RNA complement should handle invalid DNA input" do
    expected = None
    actual = toRNA "ACGTXXXCTTAA"
    label "expected" expected
    label "actual" actual
    ensureEqual expected actual

test> rna.tests = join [
  rna.test.t1,
  rna.test.t2,
  rna.test.t3,
  rna.test.t4,
  rna.test.t5,
  rna.test.t6,
  rna.test.t7
]
